title: Heart Disease MLOps - Monitoring
description: Traffic, latency, errors, model behaviour, input drift and resources for the heart-disease API (Docker Compose and Kubernetes deployments).

panels.title: Targets up
panels.description: Scrape targets Prometheus can reach (1 per running API deployment)

panels.title: High-risk share
panels.description: Share of predictions classified as heart disease

panels.title: Model loaded
panels.description: 1 = model loaded on every selected instance

panels.title: HTTP latency heatmap
panels.description: Colour = number of requests in each latency bucket

targets.expr: sum by (handler) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"fastapi-ml-app.*", deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (handler) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"fastapi-ml-app.*", deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (handler, status) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"fastapi-ml-app.*", deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", status=~"4xx|5xx"}[$__rate_interval]))
